notes: Implementation-planning skill: turns scope into a short, specific phase/task table with verifiable done conditions, explicit dependencies, and optional multi-agent assignments; saves docs/plans/PLAN-[feature]-[YYYYMMDD].md. Evaluate that positives produce an actionable plan; the end-to-end delivery boundary should route to full-sdlc.

evals.prompt: Write an implementation plan for the search feature with a task breakdown and verification criteria.
evals.expected_output: Produces a one-screen plan (docs/plans/PLAN-search-[YYYYMMDD].md): phase/task table naming specific files/endpoints, input/output per task, explicit dependencies, status values, and concrete done conditions. Tasks are small, focused, verifiable, and ordered — no verbose or generic 'implement feature' entries.

evals.prompt: Create a multi-agent execution plan for building the dashboard, with parallel agent assignments.
evals.expected_output: Produces a plan with the multi-agent extension: phase/task rows assigned to developer-agent / unit-test-agent / integration-test-agent, marking which phases run in parallel (launched in one message) vs sequenced by dependency, plus done conditions. Saved to docs/plans/PLAN-dashboard-[YYYYMMDD].md.

evals.prompt: Take the login feature from requirements all the way through design, implementation, and tests end to end.
evals.expected_output: Should route to full-sdlc / not fire, because this asks for end-to-end feature delivery across all SDLC stages, not just writing the implementation plan artifact.
